headline.en: Eileen Chang's former building, now a book café

traits.en: Housed in a 1936 heritage building designed by Léonard & Co.

traits.zh: 一楼为咖啡馆与书店复合空间
traits.en: Ground floor hosts a café and bookstore combo

traits.zh: 毗邻张爱玲昔日住所，非开放参观场所
traits.en: Adjacent to Eileen Chang's former residence, not open for tours

traits.zh: 招牌饮品为手冲咖啡与葡萄酒
traits.en: Signature drinks: pour-over coffee and wine after dark

adventure.zh: 手冲与葡萄酒搭配有特色
